name: @studio/studio-harness
description: Studio Harness MCP server: local coding/project harness (filesystem, code search & intelligence, git, shell/PowerShell, REPL, LSP)

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'module'; import { fileURLToPath as __fileURLToPath } from 'url'; import { dirname as __pathDirname } from 'path'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url); const __filename = __fileURLToPath(import.meta.url); const __dirname = __pathDirname(__filename);" --target=node18 --external:node-ssh --external:ssh2 --external:cpu-features --outfile=dist/index.js
